Rules:
When this feature is deployed to a Dropsite, 4 friendly Battalions are automatically deployed to that Dropsite.
While Activating Dropsites (during 8.1.1 Activating Dropsites), if you have more Battalions on this feature than any opponent, you count as controlling the Dropsite this Feature is deployed to and may attack with all its Scenario Feature Weapons and/or launch all available Assets from Scenario Features. If multiple players count as controlling the same Dropsite this way, this effect is ignored.
